data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'zayt' meaning olive, and 'ana' meaning I or mine. It symbolizes the beauty and fragrance of an olive tree, and the nurturing and protective nature of a mother.

in_arabic.name: زينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زينة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'زين' الذي يعني التزيين والتجميل، ويشير إلى الجمال والزينة. في القرآن الكريم، يذكر الله تعالى في سورة الجمعة الآية 5 ' يزينهم الله في الجنة '، مما يبرز معنى الزينة الإلهية. تاريخياً، كان اسم زينة شائعًا بين النساء في العصور الإسلامية الوسطى، وكان يرمز إلى الأنوثة والجمال الروحي.

in_urdu.name: زینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام زینہ عربی جڑ 'زین' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور آرائش کرنا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، زینہ ایک مقبول نام رہا ہے جو خوبصورتی، شرافت، اور روحانی جمال کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़ायना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम ज़ायना का अर्थ है सुंदरता और सजावट। हिंदुस्तानी मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो सुंदरता, सादगी, और गरिमा की प्रतीक होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: زاينه
in_pashto.long_meaning: د زاينه نوم مانا ښکلا او پېښليک دی. په پښتني روايت کې، دا نوم د ښځو لپاره کارول کيږي چې د ښکلا، نرمي، او روحاني جمال څښتنې دي.

in_english.name: Zayana
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zayana originates from the Arabic root 'zayn', meaning to adorn or beautify. It symbolizes beauty, decoration, and spiritual elegance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify feminine charm and inner beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zayana holds rich cultural significance for many Muslims as it is derived from the Arabic language, which is the language of the Holy Quran and the primary language used in Islamic religious texts and practices. Moreover, the name is an homage to the beautiful olive trees that have long been a symbol of peace, prosperity, and unity in the Islamic world. The name's association with the olive tree also reflects a love and appreciation for nature and the environment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zayana holds great spiritual significance for Muslims, as it symbolizes the nurturing and protective nature of Allah (God) towards His creation. The name's derivation from 'zayt' (olive) and 'ana' (I or mine) reflects the divine love of Allah towards His creation, which is likened to the precious olives that are a source of nourishment and life. Additionally, the name's association with a mother's love and protective nature reflects the unwavering and cherishing care that Allah has for all of His creation.
